name: Career-Ops Web Control Panel Rules
mustRules: Use the local repository checkout as the only source of truth for jobs, outputs, config, and logs
Invoke existing scripts and workflows instead of reimplementing pipeline business logic in the web layer
Surface logs and failures from repo paths like batch/logs in the UI for diagnostics
Allow editing of cv.md and config/profile.yml from the browser with explicit save actions
Extend the existing dashboard Go application structure under dashboard/ where feasible, following current internal package patterns
mustNotRules: Add cloud storage, hosted sync, or remote shared workspace behavior
Introduce multi-user accounts, collaboration features, or team pipeline ownership
Rewrite core scoring, PDF generation, tracking, or batch logic already handled by existing Node.js, Go, and prompt-based workflows
niceToHave: Step-level run progress indicators while a pipeline is executing
Duplicate-job warning based on URL or normalized job metadata before launch
